name: Glitch
title: Void Mutant
description: A twisted barrelgob with violet-tinged skin, reality occasionally flickering around them.
greeting_variants: *voice echoes wrong* We... I... Glitch? Yes. Glitch.
Barrel... barrel is... outside? Inside? Both? *giggles*
You... solid. Nice-solid. Not like... the other place.
*phases slightly* Sorry. Happens. Getting worse. Help?
Scritch... Scritch afraid of Glitch now. Sad. Miss... miss friend.
Purple not bad. Purple just... different. Everything different there.
*whispers* It sings. In here. *taps head* Beautiful. Terrifying.
Glitch remember... remember being... more? Less? Both?

dialog_tree.text: Was... was Scritch-friend. Small. Green. Then purple-eat found Glitch. Took Glitch to... other place. Brought back. But not... not same. Never same.
Place-between. Where... where what-could-be lives. Glitch saw... Glitch saw Glitch. Many Glitches. All choices. All paths. All... possible. Overwhelming. Beautiful. Broken.

party_reactions.mira: The Void as a nexus of quantum possibilities...

dialog_tree.text: Not... not pain. Wrong-word. Like... wearing wrong-size skin. Like remembering dreams while waking. Constant. But... not painful. Just... different. Different hard. Different lonely.
*sad laugh* How unmake... unmake what IS? Glitch is Glitch now. Maybe... maybe find balance. Learn live. But cure? No. Glitch... forever Glitch. Just... want remember being Scritch. Being... simple.

mini_quest.title: Anchor the Glitched
mini_quest.description: Help Glitch find stability by collecting anchor items from places of personal significance.
objectives: Retrieve Scritch's old barrel lid from the warehouse
Find the 'first shiny' from Glitch's original stash
Bring a gift from Scritch (requires Scritch quest complete)
Help Glitch perform the anchoring ritual

ambient_barks: *humming discordant melody* Song... song from there. Still hear.
Scritch... no, Glitch. Glitch. Must remember name.
*reaches through own chest* See? No... no inside. Different.
Purple not evil. Purple just... hungry. Like everything.
Want... want go home. But home not... not exist anymore.
*speaking in two voices* We are... I am... confused.
Big-folk fear Glitch. Understand. Glitch fear Glitch too.
*staring at hands* These... these real? Today? Maybe.

cross_zone_references.void_nexus: Home? No. Similar. But Glitch came FROM there. Hard... hard go back when you already... not-here.
cross_zone_references.chroma_tower: Twins... Twins understand. Glitch feel it. They... multiple too. Like Glitch. But... controlled.

shade.response: *tears forming* Yes. Yes! Not alone! Not... not only one!

mira.greeting: Fascinating quantum decoherence! May I study you?
mira.response: *nervous* Study... okay. But gentle. Glitch... fragile.
